svg.aria-label: Placing the cell in the holder: the negative cap faces the side wired to the red and white leads, with the contacts pressing on the center of the flat faces. Contacts touching the crimped rim is wrong: the rim belongs to the positive case and would short the positive and negative terminals. Squeeze the hand clip open, push the cell all the way in, release, and check all four contacts. Wipe the cell case clean first.

svg.text: Cap toward red/white side; contacts at center
